scripts.fmt: bunx prettier --write apps/cli/src apps/cli/tests apps/web/src apps/web/index.html packages/shared/src package.json apps/*/package.json packages/*/package.json docs/package.json tsconfig.json apps/*/tsconfig.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.fmt:check: bunx prettier --check apps/cli/src apps/cli/tests apps/web/src apps/web/index.html packages/shared/src package.json apps/*/package.json packages/*/package.json docs/package.json tsconfig.json apps/*/tsconfig.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.lint: bunx eslint apps/cli/src apps/cli/tests apps/web/src packages/shared/src
scripts.check: bunx tsc --noEmit --project apps/cli/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit --project apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:parity: bun run compile && BENTO_BIN=$PWD/dist/bento REQUIRE_BENTO_BIN=1 bun test apps/cli/tests/contract/parity_test.ts --timeout 120000
scripts.smoke:compiled: bun run compile && dist/bento version && dist/bento --stack ${BENTO_SMOKE_STACK:-/tmp/bento-smoke-$$} init && dist/bento --stack ${BENTO_SMOKE_STACK:-/tmp/bento-smoke-$$} render && dist/bento --stack ${BENTO_SMOKE_STACK:-/tmp/bento-smoke-$$} status
scripts.ci: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run check && bun run test && bun run test:integration
scripts.serve: bun run web:build && bun run apps/cli/src/main.ts serve
